description.en: Sort an array containing only 0s, 1s, and 2s without using any sorting algorithm.
description.hi: Ek array jisme sirf 0, 1 aur 2 hain, bina sorting algorithm ke sort karo.

hints.en: Use Dutch National Flag (3 pointers: low, mid, high)
hints.hi: Dutch National Flag use karo (3 pointers: low, mid, high)

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
# Sort and print

approach.en: Dutch National Flag: 3 pointers partition into 0s, 1s, 2s.
approach.hi: Dutch National Flag: 3 pointers se 0s, 1s, 2s partition karo.

code.python:
lo,mid,hi=0,0,len(arr)-1
while mid<=hi:
  if arr[mid]==0: arr[lo],arr[mid]=arr[mid],arr[lo]; lo+=1; mid+=1
  elif arr[mid]==1: mid+=1
  else: arr[mid],arr[hi]=arr[hi],arr[mid]; hi-=1
print(*arr)

description.en: Given elevation map, compute how much water it can trap after raining.
description.hi: Elevation map diya hai, baarish ke baad kitna paani bhar sakta hai compute karo.

hints.en: For each bar, water = min(maxLeft, maxRight) - height
hints.hi: Har bar ke liye, paani = min(maxLeft, maxRight) - height

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
# Compute trapped water
starterCode.javascript:
const lines = require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8').trim().split('\n');
const arr = lines[1].split(' ').map(Number);

approach.en: Two pointer approach from both ends.
approach.hi: Dono ends se two pointer approach.

code.python:
l,r=0,n-1
lm=rm=water=0
while l<r:
  if arr[l]<arr[r]:
    if arr[l]>=lm: lm=arr[l]
    else: water+=lm-arr[l]
    l+=1
  else:
    if arr[r]>=rm: rm=arr[r]
    else: water+=rm-arr[r]
    r-=1
print(water)

description.en: Find the next lexicographically greater permutation of the array.
description.hi: Array ki next lexicographically greater permutation dhundho.

hints.en: Find rightmost pair where arr[i] < arr[i+1]
hints.hi: Rightmost pair dhundho jahan arr[i] < arr[i+1]

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
# Find next permutation
starterCode.javascript:
const lines = require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8').trim().split('\n');
const arr = lines[1].split(' ').map(Number);

approach.en: 1) Find breakpoint i where arr[i]<arr[i+1] from right. 2) Swap with next larger. 3) Reverse suffix.
approach.hi: 1) Right se breakpoint dhundho jahan arr[i]<arr[i+1]. 2) Next larger se swap karo. 3) Suffix reverse karo.

code.python:
i=len(arr)-2
while i>=0 and arr[i]>=arr[i+1]: i-=1
if i>=0:
  j=len(arr)-1
  while arr[j]<=arr[i]: j-=1
  arr[i],arr[j]=arr[j],arr[i]
arr[i+1:]=arr[i+1:][::-1]
print(*arr)

description.en: Find the contiguous subarray with the largest product.
description.hi: Wo contiguous subarray dhundho jiska product sabse bada ho.

hints.en: Track both max and min product (negative * negative = positive)
hints.hi: Max aur min product dono track karo (negative * negative = positive)

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
# Find max product
starterCode.javascript:
const lines = require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8').trim().split('\n');
const arr = lines[1].split(' ').map(Number);

approach.en: Track max and min product at each position.
approach.hi: Har position pe max aur min product track karo.

code.python:
mx=mn=ans=arr[0]
for x in arr[1:]:
  if x<0: mx,mn=mn,mx
  mx=max(x,mx*x)
  mn=min(x,mn*x)
  ans=max(ans,mx)
print(ans)
